headline: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited Receives NCLT Approval for Commerce Vertical Demerger
sum: Veranda Learning Solutions has obtained NCLT approval for the demerger of its Commerce vertical, marking a key corporate restructuring step to separate the Commerce education business into a standalone entity.
implication: Demerger via NCLT order confirms the statutory scheme route under Companies Act s.391–394 is viable for EdTech verticals; subsequent RoC filing and stock exchange listing of the demerged entity will trigger additional disclosure and regulatory gating.
detail: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited, a listed EdTech platform, has secured National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) approval for the demerger of its Commerce education vertical into a separate entity. This approval, granted on or before 24 August 2026, represents completion of the judicial approval phase under the Companies Act, 2013 scheme framework. The next steps typically include filing with the Registrar of Companies and, if intended for public markets, stock exchange listing compliance. The structure isolates the Commerce vertical's operations, assets, and liabilities into an independent corporate entity while maintaining shareholder continuity through shareholding in both the resulting and demerged companies.
